name: spark-dating-platform
description: Cross-platform dating app monorepo for web, mobile, desktop, and API.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @spark/shared run build && npm --workspace @spark/ui run build && npm --workspace @spark/api run build && npm --workspace @spark/web run build && npm --workspace @spark/mobile run build && npm --workspace @spark/desktop run build
scripts.netlify:build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run test && npm --workspace @spark/web run typecheck && npm --workspace @spark/web run build && node scripts/verify-netlify-output.mjs
